class Getter:
 @property
 def __doc__(self):
  print("lookup")
  if ready: old.__name__="after"
  return "doc"
ready=False
g=Getter()
old=property(g)
old.__name__="before"
ready=True
new=old.setter(None)
print(new.__name__,old.__name__)

def second(obj): pass
class Getter:
 @property
 def __doc__(self):
  if ready: old.__doc__="changed"
  return "doc"
ready=False
g=Getter()
old=property(g,second)
ready=True
new=old.setter(None)
print(new.fget is g,new.fset is second,new.__doc__,old.__doc__)
